meta.semantics: two-hop EAX->S-slot->consumer type propagation: call G@cs in F defines EAX:F:cs==RET:G (flow_chains); a CFG-join engine (snapshot-rebuilt, callee-saved aliasing, per-binding call-site) binds slot stores mov [esp|ebp+..+var_N],reg to that call; the slot carries instruction-semantic types (SG/IV S-entities). If EVERY textual write to the slot key in F is a carrier store bound to the SAME single callee G (unique write source; S->S unique-writer chains resolved to a RET root), then each binding's EAX:F:cs <= types(slot) and RET:G <= intersection of types over all its unique-writer slots. ffl4/ffl5 surviving RET->S edges are unioned in as a cross-engine fallback for unbound reg stores.
meta.soundness: unique-writer verified by full textual census of writes to the slot key (imm/subreg/rmw/fpu/xchg/pop/unbound writes discard — subreg stores are unsound to propagate: short x=f() and (short)f_int() compile alike); multi-callee / mixed-source / cyclic chains discard; RET aggregation requires non-empty intersection; types spelled verbatim from source anchors; EAX entities restricted to the flow_chains universe.
